notes: «أن عمر بن الخطاب ... حمل على فرس» describes Umar's action inside the story, so he is in the scene and not a link (rule 6); the chain ends at Ibn Umar, who relays the Prophet's words

fixes.reason: Umar ibn al-Khattab is the subject of the story, not a transmitter, so rule 6 leaves him out

evidence.quote: أن عمر بن الخطاب، - رضى الله عنه - حمل على فرس
